headline: No late-game outs found for your starters. Price stays in. If you still have no TE or QB, add AJ Barner before 1:05 PM Pacific and Aaron Rodgers before 5:20 PM Pacific.
alerts: Before 1:05 PM Pacific: Seattle posted seven inactives, led by Sam Darnold. No report lists Jadarian Price as inactive, so keep him in at RB.
If you have not filled TE yet (Hockenson is OUT), add AJ Barner (SEA, 1:05 PM Pacific) before kickoff and drop Seth McGowan or Germie Bernard.
If you have not filled QB yet, add Aaron Rodgers (PIT at CIN, 5:20 PM Pacific) before his game.
ESPN reported no fantasy-relevant injuries for the Sunday night game. Ladd McConkey (back) is the Monday night name to watch.
This run could not open Sleeper or the full Seahawks inactive names, so check the Sleeper app for a red OUT tag on Price before 1:05 PM Pacific.

DET.note: Plays New England in Munich Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. Lions -2.5, total 49.5, about 26 implied. St. Brown active. D.J. Reed and Kerby Joseph out.

NE.note: Plays Detroit in Munich Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific. About 23.5 implied. A.J. Brown and Rhamondre Stevenson active. Carlton Davis inactive.

MIN.note: At Green Bay Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Packers -2.5, total 42.5, Vikings about 20 implied. Hockenson, Jennings and Kyler Murray out, Addison questionable.

GB.note: Hosts Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. About 22.5 implied. Josh Jacobs and Micah Parsons out.

NYJ.note: Hosts Buffalo Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bills -8.5, total 50.5, Jets about 21 implied. Garrett Wilson questionable.

SEA.note: At Las Vegas Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Seahawks -6.5, total 40.5. Seven inactives including Darnold. Drew Lock starts, Shaheed back, LT Charles Cross out.

IND.note: Hosts Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Colts -3.5, total 38.5, about 21 implied.

MIA.note: At Indianapolis. Kyle McCord starts with Willis on IR.

PIT.note: At Cincinnati Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. Bengals -3.5, total 49.5. ESPN reported no fantasy-relevant injuries for this game.

NYG.note: Lost 24-21 to Washington Thursday. Done for the week.
